name: consult
description: A mod that registers the mcp__consult__consult tool: a read-only diff or plan review by codex (OpenAI, the default, on the user's locked codex-consult app server) or agy (Google Gemini), with a repo opt-out marker, a secret-file block, timeouts and a read-only agy hook gate.

enabled.title: Enable the mod
enabled.description: Off: the consult tool is not registered, so no code or plan text can be sent to codex or agy. Only an exact false turns it off. Takes effect after a reload or in a new session.

codexSocket.title: Codex app server socket
codexSocket.description: Unix socket of the running codex app server (README: Run the codex app server). Empty: $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/codex-consult.sock. Allowed characters: A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ / -

codexLockPolicy.title: Codex lock policy
codexLockPolicy.description: How consult checks the codex app server's lockdown. Empty or thread: check each guarantee on the consult thread, and require of the server only what consult cannot set per thread. strict: require every lock flag of the server itself, as consult 0.2 did. Allowed values: empty, thread, strict
